title: Search files
intro: Find a text in the files of a commit, as they were then: HEAD, a branch, a tag or any commit. Binary files are skipped. Click a line to see it in its file.
atHelp: A branch, a tag or a commit's sha
pathHelp: A folder, a file or a glob, from the opened folder
cut: There are more matches than these: narrow the search to see the rest.
